title: Metodbox AI
summary: An AI assistant for an education platform with close to 600,000 users. It answers from about 65,000 videos and more than 30,000 books linked to the curriculum, adapts to the user's role, and lets users act on the platform in natural language through LangGraph multi-agent workflows. I led it from planning to deployment, and rebuilt its book-content RAG pipeline; the video pipeline is next.

title: bkai: LLM question and image generation
summary: An LLM service that generates educational questions and images for teachers. I am building its next version, with versioned questions and images that can be regenerated up to three times, teacher-written image prompts and queued generation jobs on AWS Lambda, and I am leading its migration to Kubernetes on AWS EKS.

title: Notification System for Metodbox and Uğur Dijital
summary: A notification system for two education platforms with close to 600,000 users. It handles more than 60 instant and scheduled notification types, with override rules that cancel reminders that no longer apply, and delivers more than 8,000 notifications a day to web and mobile.

title: Integrations with 20+ Education Platforms
summary: Integrations that connect Metodbox and Uğur Dijital with more than 20 external products, from online book libraries to platforms such as Pickatale and Kodris. Each partner has its own authentication method, and I worked with every partner from the first meeting to the final implementation.

title: Admin Panel for Seçenek
summary: The admin panel of Seçenek, a platform for students preparing for Turkey's university entrance exam. I built its backend from scratch as microservices: authentication, roles and permissions, bulk user import in the background, purchase and refund reports, and management of curriculum, exams, packages and discount codes.

title: PayFlex (ATS) Web Pages
summary: Full-stack pages for ATS (Alacak Takip Sistemi), a receivables-tracking product that is today PayFlex, built during a long-term internship, together with Cucumber test suites for its web services.

title: Twitter API Streaming System
summary: A streaming system that feeds QOSHE's news platform from the Twitter API, written with the emphasis on fault tolerance and maintainability, because a stream has to keep running.
